$captured.principals: super: the plaintext listener's ANONYMOUS principal, a super user; mcp-wide: SCRAM-SHA-512 over TLS, Describe on every topic and the cluster; mcp-narrow: SCRAM-SHA-512 over TLS, Describe on the topics prefixed app- only
